_comment: See README.md section 'IIS deployment' before going live with IIS.

ConnectionStrings._comment_IIS: Trusted_Connection above almost never works under IIS, because IIS runs the app as its own Windows account, not yours. Easiest fix: create a SQL login, then replace the MountainApp line above with the SQL login connection string.

SuperAdmin._comment_ResetPassword: Lost the superadmin password? Set ResetPassword below to any new password (10+ characters), restart the app (recycle the IIS app pool), sign in with it, then clear this field and restart again.
